notes: Single main article, no supplementary file. H2 uptake is the authors' own volumetric (manometric) excess adsorption at 77.3 K up to 50 MPa on AX21 (Maxsorb MSC-30) and AC35 activated carbons (and zeolite 13X for comparison). Table 2 heads the area column BET, but Section 2.1 says 'For the calculation of the surface area the Langmuir equation was used'; I4 is met either way because a specific surface area is reported. Not retracted per record.json and no retraction notice in the text. Authors cite earlier room-temperature HPD-RT work but do not state that all reported H2 uptake values were previously published, so duplicate_data does not apply.
